workflow: A freshly owned AutoCAD 2024 process creates the fixed native A3 layout, plots through DWG To PDF.pc3, saves and reopens the scratch DWG, then plots a second time before restoring the original process set.
result: Both native A3 PDFs contained vector and text operators with zero image XObjects and rendered sharply in Poppler. The known duplicate /PageMode catalog defect is explicitly recorded by strict pypdf; tolerant pypdf, pdfplumber and Poppler all reopened the files.
